description: Handoff from supera-reviewer to the orchestrator. One review per dispatch; an empty findings list means nothing to report.

findings.description: Defects found in the change, one entry per defect. Empty when the change is clean.

file.description: Path of the changed or untracked file, relative to the worktree root.

line.description: 1-based line in the file's current content; for something absent, the line where the fix belongs.

severity.description: blocker: wrong behaviour or data loss on a stated requirement. important: likely bug or missing test on a changed path. minor: everything else.

title: supera-reviewer review
